narration: Why do traders call it Doctor Copper? Copper is one of the five commodities on Meme Street. In the real world, it's the metal inside almost every electric cable. Demand comes from wiring, construction, and electric cars, which use far more copper than petrol ones. Because it's used everywhere, its price is seen as a health check for the economy. That's the doctor. What makes it different is that electric cars and power grids need lots of it. What can push it down? A slowing economy, new mines opening, and weak building data. On Meme Street, data and headlines hit the news wire, and the price reacts. Trade copper at memestreet.net.
